LoginError.text: Something went wrong while logging in. Please try again.

Forbidden.title: You do not have permission
Forbidden.text: You do not have permission to see this page. Ask a admin if you need it.

NotFound.title: Page not found

About.title: About
About.heading: About Spexify
About.description: Spexify is provided by FGV and collects the songs the spex have recorded over the years.
About.feedbackDescription: We value your opinion. Do you have suggestions for improvements or have you found a bug? Get in touch at {email}.

Support.title: Support
Support.heading: How can we help?
Support.description: Found a technical problem, or trouble logging in or with an app? We are happy to help.
Support.contactDescription: Describe your problem as clearly as possible. Get in touch at {email}.

Home.title: Spexify
Home.mustBeLoggedIn: Log in with your FGV account to listen.
Home.intro: The songs of the spex through the years. Listen here, or in a Subsonic app on your phone through My apps.

Album.noTracks: The album has no tracks yet.
Album.starFailed: The star could not be saved.

Player.label: Player
Player.error: The track could not be played.

Search.title: Search
Search.hint: Search albums, track titles, performers, melodies and lyrics. At least two characters.

Starred.title: Starred
Starred.text: Tracks you have starred, here and in your apps.
Starred.none: You have not starred anything yet.

Playlists.title: Playlists
Playlists.text: Your playlists show here and in your apps. Add tracks from a track's menu.
Playlists.unavailable: The music server is not answering right now.

Apps.title: My apps
Apps.intro: Listen in a Subsonic app on your phone, e.g. Symfonium, DSub, play:Sub or Substreamer. Create one app password per device. A password unused for {months} months expires, and all stop working if your access to Spexify is removed.
Apps.connectText: Enter the server address and your username in the app, and an app password you create below.
Apps.name: Name
Apps.shownOnce: It is shown only now. Enter it in the app before you close this.
Apps.confirmRevoke: Revoke? The app using it stops working.
Apps.apiKeysText: Apps that support OpenSubsonic API keys can use a key instead of a username and password.

Manage.newAlbumText: Pick the spex the album belongs to. Title and year come from the spex unless you give others. The album is unpublished until you publish it.
Manage.title: Title
Manage.spexSearch: Search spex by title or year
Manage.spexHint: Leave empty for an album not about one spex, e.g. a compilation.
Manage.posterFallback: Without a cover, the spex poster is shown.
Manage.publishText: Published albums and tracks are visible to everyone and in the apps.
Manage.formats: FLAC, MP3, AAC/M4A, Ogg Vorbis, Opus or WAV. Large files are uploaded in parts and survive interruptions.
Manage.noTracks: No tracks yet. Upload audio files above.
Manage.trashAlbum: Move the album to the trash
Manage.trashAlbumText: The album is hidden everywhere except the trash, and can be restored from there.
Manage.lyricsSynced: The lyrics are synchronised (LRC with timestamps)

Trash.title: Trash
Trash.text: Albums and tracks in the trash are hidden from everyone. Restore them here; an admin can delete them for good.
Trash.textAdmin: Albums and tracks in the trash are hidden from everyone. Deleting removes the files for good.
Trash.confirmDelete: Delete {title} and its files for good?
Trash.confirmEmpty: Delete everything in the trash and its files for good?

Audit.title: Change log
Audit.text: Your own changes to the catalogue.
Audit.textAdmin: Every change to the catalogue and the settings.

AdminLibrary.title: Music server
AdminLibrary.text: Navidrome plays the published tracks for the apps. It reads the music folder after every change.
AdminLibrary.rescanRequested: The scan starts within ten seconds

AdminMaintenance.title: Maintenance
AdminMaintenance.text: The jobs the server runs on a schedule, in Swedish time. You can also start one now.
AdminMaintenance.started: {job} has started. It runs in the background.

SPEX_REFRESH.title: Spex refresh
SPEX_REFRESH.description: Copies the current titles, years and categories of the spex from Spexregister to the albums.

UPLOAD_CLEANUP.title: Upload cleanup
UPLOAD_CLEANUP.description: Removes uploads that were started but never used, with their files.

AdminUsers.title: Users
AdminUsers.text: Everyone who has used Spexify. Access is granted and removed in Keycloak; here you revoke app passwords and lift lock-outs after failed logins.
AdminUsers.confirmRevoke: Revoke all app passwords and keys of {username}?
